svg.title: Cutaway turbine with supported rotor and fixed guide vanes
svg.desc: Editorial engineering illustration, not a fabrication drawing or Anatomy output. Three rotor rows and two stationary guide-vane rows sit on separate axial planes inside a split housing. Shaft bearings sit outside the housing. Two curved saddles support the housing above bolted rails. A service line runs around the front, clear of the rotating bore. Rotor tips have three units of clearance to the inner casing. SVG animations show rotation and airflow.
svg.text: 3 rotor rows · 2 guide-vane rows · 2 shaft bearings · 2 housing saddles
